capabilities: Render interactive 3D anatomy models inline from anatomed code blocks
Isolate anatomical regions with isolated, related, or regional detail levels
Toggle structures on and off in a per-model legend
Open or create linked notes by clicking structures in the model
Fetch GLB models from a configurable asset base URL
extras: Desktop only for now; the plugin fetches 3D models from one host (default: the project's public Supabase bucket) and licenses everything under CC BY-SA 4.0.
problem: Obsidian has no way to view rotatable, region-focused 3D anatomy inside notes, so anatomy knowledge maps can't reference actual spatial structures.

relations.evidence: The anatomy is derived from Z-Anatomy (Kervyn & Zielinski, CC BY-SA 4.0)

summary: Anatomy embed plugin that renders interactive, region-isolated 3D anatomy models inline via anatomed code blocks with toggling legends and linked structure notes.
